introduction: Mississippi LIHEAP helps eligible households with home-energy expenses. A local Community Action Agency completes the full application.
description: Mississippi LIHEAP helps eligible households with home-energy expenses. A local Community Action Agency completes the full application.

sections.who: Household income and program conditions apply. The agency screens the household and current assistance availability.
sections.get: Help can address qualifying energy costs. Explain a shutoff notice or other urgent energy problem directly to the agency.
sections.docs:
• Household identity and income information.
  • Utility or fuel bills and account details.
  • Any disconnection notice.
sections.apply:
1. Submit a pre-application

    Follow MDHS LIHEAP instructions through Access MS.

  2. Attend the agency appointment

    The local CAA helps complete the full application.

  3. Supply remaining records

    Ask what additional information your case needs.
sections.after: Contact the CAA about status and notify it of changing emergency deadlines.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Mississippi LIHEAP application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is the pre-application the final decision?
No. The agency completes full intake.
Do not assume it does; contact the utility and agency.
